speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I am Dr. Agent; since you are a newborn, I will be speaking with your parents or guardian to understand your condition. Please tell me how long the baby has been crying, any changes in feeding, and if you have noticed any fever or vomiting.

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Sepsis (suspected Group B Streptococcus or E. coli) given term birth, lack of prenatal care, no immunizations, and clinical presentation of crying. I will proceed with immediate workup.
